Netgear R6850 Wireless AC2000 Dual-Band Gigabit WiFi Router – High-Speed Performance for Smooth Streaming & Gaming


Upgrade your home or office network with the Netgear R6850 AC2000 Dual-Band Gigabit Router, delivering ultra-fast wireless speeds up to 2000 Mbps. Powered by 802.11ac WiFi technology, this router offers simultaneous dual-band connectivity (2.4GHz & 5GHz) to reduce interference and optimize performance for HD streaming, online gaming, and heavy-duty browsing.

Equipped with four high-performance external antennas and MU-MIMO technology, the R6850 ensures stable, high-speed connections across multiple devices. Its Gigabit Ethernet ports provide lightning-fast wired connections for PCs, smart TVs, game consoles, and more.

With advanced security features, parental controls, and easy setup via the Netgear Nighthawk App, the R6850 is the perfect blend of power, speed, and reliability.

Key Features:

  • Wireless speed up to 2000 Mbps (AC2000)
  • Dual-band (2.4GHz + 5GHz) for reduced interference
  • 4 external antennas for wider WiFi coverage
  • MU-MIMO for simultaneous streaming on multiple devices
  • 4x Gigabit LAN ports + 1x WAN port
  • Smart parental controls & guest network access
  • Easy setup with Netgear Nighthawk App


Ideal for: Homes with multiple devices, HD video streaming, online gaming, and smart home setups.
